ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the effectiveness of the new prevention plan
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Is the new prevention plan effective?
ideas.insight: I believe that investigating Medicaid fraud in Minnesota could uncover significant waste and abuse. By analyzing data and conducting interviews, we could shed light on the issue and hold those responsible accountable.
